meal_planning.label: Help customers find meals that fit their preferences
meal_planning.what: An AI product described as helping with recipes or meal plans.
meal_planning.why: This may help you prepare meal ideas for the customer preferences you described.
meal_planning.action: Try one fictional customer request on its product website. Check every preference yourself before using a plan with a real customer.
meal_planning.caution: Food preferences, allergies and dietary suitability still need human review; no dietary safety has been established.

customer_support.label: Spend less time answering routine customer questions
customer_support.what: An AI product described as helping answer customer questions.
customer_support.why: This may reduce the time you spend drafting answers to the routine questions you mentioned.
customer_support.action: Open its product website and try one common customer question with invented details. Compare the answer with what you would send.
customer_support.caution: Accuracy, customer-data handling and the need for human approval remain unverified.

appointments.label: Make customer bookings easier to manage
appointments.what: An AI product described as helping with bookings or scheduling.
appointments.why: This may help you manage the booking work you described; it has not been shown to prevent missed appointments.
appointments.action: Try booking one fictional appointment on its website. Check reminders, cancellation rules and pricing before connecting your calendar.
appointments.caution: Calendar compatibility, reminders, customer consent and any effect on missed appointments remain unverified.

marketing_content.label: Create a first draft for reaching more customers
marketing_content.what: An AI product described as helping draft marketing content.
marketing_content.why: This may give you a first draft for the promotion work you mentioned, rather than starting from a blank page.
marketing_content.action: Use its product website to draft one short post from a non-sensitive business description. Review its facts and tone before publishing anything.
marketing_content.caution: Content accuracy, usage rights, brand fit and any increase in customers remain unverified.

business_admin.label: Spend less time reading and organizing paperwork
business_admin.what: An AI product described as helping handle documents or routine paperwork.
business_admin.why: This may reduce repeated reading or copying in the paperwork task you described.
business_admin.action: Try a made-up document on its product website. Check the result against the original before considering real business records.
business_admin.caution: Document accuracy, privacy, retention, legal obligations and integration effort remain unverified.
